content.short: Mt Pelerin lets users buy, swap, and cash out crypto from any wallet, with no identification required.
content.description: Mt Pelerin is a Swiss fintech that bridges crypto with traditional finance. Its core offerings include Bridge Wallet, which simplifies investments in Bitcoin and Ethereum, and Bridge Protocol, a technology for asset tokenization. The company envisions a full-reserve account intended to keep 100% of deposits secure in Switzerland, while enabling support for multiple currencies, tokenization capabilities, and access to a digital asset marketplace.
